result: Sofia sketched a fish and split the work: Jack took the top line, and she took the bottom. Jack started running the top line while Sofia drew from the nose, and Omar hauled a full load of dominoes back from the bin. Omar nudged a jammed domino at the nose fork into line, then carried the top line up into the flare when it stopped short. Jack finished the top tail and took the bottom flare, where the join stayed pale. Hana spotted dominoes sitting off the path, but Jack and Omar doubled up on the same spot. Jack rebuilt the bridge after Sofia advised him to carry the bottom line on, then bend gently into the flare. Sofia closed the last gap herself. "Hands off, everyone. It's looking like a fish." At the push, 101 of 108 dominoes fell. All three judges saw a fish outline, though one saw a leaf.
